title: Pontotoc swimmers sell $25 yard signs to help pay for championship rings
excerpt: The sale runs through Dec. 4. Designs include signs for the Class of 2027, district schools, sports and the arts.
locality: Pontotoc City Schools in Pontotoc, Mississippi.

facts.statement: Pontotoc High School swimmers are selling $25 yard signs through Friday, Dec. 4, to help buy championship rings. The team also plans to use the proceeds for remaining program expenses and the next swim season, Pontotoc Athletics announced Tuesday.
facts.evidence: The November 17 team announcement lists all three uses of the proceeds, the cost per one-sided sign and sale dates.
facts.date_context: Sale November 16 through December 4, 2026. The state meet took place October 17, 2026, in Tupelo.
facts.locality: Pontotoc City Schools in Pontotoc, Mississippi.
facts.identities: Pontotoc High School swim team, Pearl River Central and West Jones.

facts.statement: The one-sided signs come in designs for individual schools as well as teams and clubs. Families can choose a Class of 2027 senior sign, for example, or one for band, choir, drama, gaming or JROTC. The school’s announcement shows the designs, including a state champion swimming sign.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc High School swimmers are selling $25 yard signs through Friday, Dec. 4, to help buy championship rings. The team also plans to use the proceeds for remaining program expenses and the next swim season, Pontotoc Athletics announced Tuesday.

The one-sided signs come in designs for individual schools as well as teams and clubs. Families can choose a Class of 2027 senior sign, for example, or one for band, choir, drama, gaming or JROTC. The school’s announcement shows the designs, including a state champion swimming sign.
The championship behind the fundraiser came down to a tie. Pontotoc and Pearl River Central each scored 85 points in the Class II boys meet on Oct. 17 in Tupelo and shared the state title.
